mandate: C389 — test the cross-sectional intraday MINRV (minimum realized variance / jump-robust RV ratio) x SEASONAL-DISLOCATION mean-reversion stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. MINRV scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 returns ending at close bar t, X=r[t-W+1..t] (W returns): rv=sum(x_i**2); minrv=(pi/2)*(W/(W-1))*sum(min(x_i**2, x_{i-1}**2)) (minimum realized variance — jump-robust estimator from the min of adjacent squared returns); minrv_rv_ratio=minrv/max(rv,eps) (jump-robustness ratio; small when jumps dominate), eps=1e-12. NaN if t<W, any NaN/non-finite in X, rv<=eps, or non-finite output. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (minrv_dev, minrv_rv_ratio_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs/denominator requirements (t<W-1=255).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 returns ending at close bar t, X=r[t-W+1..t] (W returns): rv=sum(x_i**2); minrv=(pi/2)*(W/(W-1))*sum(min(x_i**2, x_{i-1}**2)) (minimum realized variance); minrv_rv_ratio=minrv/max(rv,eps).
methodology.signals: minrv/minrv_rv_ratio over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.minrv_vectorization_note: MINRV via sliding_window_view(returns, 257) over per-asset return series aligned to close bars; rv=sum(x^2) and minrv=sum(min(x_i^2,x_{i-1}^2)) computed via sign/shifted reductions over (n_windows, W) matrix; window-NaN enforced by finite-count over the W-bar trailing returns. No Python loop over bars x assets — validated against brute force with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
